The cda-tum URL resolves only by GitHub redirect to munich-quantum-toolkit/predictor; the artifact itself is confirmed correct.
The record's own Gate 2 text reads 'Editorial framing rather than a technique', which is a stated Gate 2 failure. Article type is SPECIAL_ISSUE_INTRO, so the original-research count does not change.

The accelerator is a coherent optical Ising machine solving a QUBO, which is CRITERIA.md false-positive class 2. The offload framing is defensible but the census places every other Ising/annealing record at BORDERLINE or EXCLUDED.

The recorded claim is 'reduced crosstalk and decoherence effects under parallel two-qubit operation', i.e. a fidelity objective. The TCAD agent's own stated decision rule puts fidelity-objective mapping papers at BORDERLINE.

QuanGuard's contribution is device fingerprinting for fraud detection; the recorded metric is device-identification accuracy. Gate 1 describes the quantum cloud's allocation behaviour as context, not as a quantity the paper improves, so the record passes on Gate 1 framing alone.
qSIEVE's stated objective is qubit overhead at a given logical error rate, i.e. a QEC-architecture result. Gate 2 rests on an analogy to systolic dataflow rather than a classical systems measurement.

The objective is remote entanglement rate against the RHG bond-failure threshold for optically networked ion modules, which sits in false-positive classes 4 and 6. No classical systems quantity is recorded, and TQE carries no gate justification to test.
Minor embedding for a quantum annealer. FGCS-063, the same problem in the same window, is BORDERLINE. The two journals treat identical work differently.

The record itself states the comparisons are across devices and algorithms rather than against a classical solver baseline, which is the 'application accuracy comparison only' shape CRITERIA.md excludes.
Quadratisation is QUBO problem preparation for annealing and QAOA toolchains; the runtime advantage is recorded without figures and without a named comparator beyond 'prior quadratisation methods'.
Gate 2 is a methodological analogy to VLSI standard cells; the layout speed-up is recorded as BASELINE_UNCLEAR with no quantified comparator, and the record's own deep-dive priority is LOW.
Control-electronics waveform memory compression, the nearest neighbour of false-positive class 6. No classical systems quantity beyond on-chip memory footprint is recorded.
The classical systems content is the avoidance of classical simulation when constructing benchmarks, not a classical systems mechanism; the record names no runtime, memory or communication quantity.
